create.name: Mirabai Bush
create.bio:
Mirabai Bush is an American teacher and writer who has spent decades bringing meditation and other contemplative practices into ordinary working life. Her own training began in India, where she spent two years with Neem Karoli Baba and sat with the Buddhist teachers S. N. Goenka and Anagarika Munindra in Bodh Gaya; later she also studied with several Tibetan lamas and with the Sufi teacher Pir Vilayat Khan, and practised Iyengar yoga and Aikido for years.

She was a founder of the nonprofit Center for Contemplative Mind in Society, which tested ways of introducing practice to universities, law firms, businesses, journalists and activists, and she helped Google build its Search Inside Yourself programme, which combines mindfulness with emotional intelligence. Before that she helped start the Seva Foundation and ran a development programme in the Guatemalan highlands. She taught alongside Ram Dass for many years and wrote two books with him, including Walking Each Other Home, drawn from his final teachings on dying. Her memoir, Almost Home, traces the path from editing fuelling manuals for the Saturn V rocket to an Indian ashram and a life of contemplative service.
